context: A boss compares business strategy to sports tactics with his manager
purpose: Teach: 兼/収め/カッコ/役に立つ/世界一/珍しく/的確/なるべく

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期の戦略だが、私はビジネスをスポーツの試合に例えて考えている。
lines.en: About this quarter's strategy, I've been thinking of business as a sports match.
lines.style: Hiroshi speaks with calm, deliberate executive authority and measured pacing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: なるほど、社長は経営者兼元アスリートですから、その視点は的確だと思います。
lines.en: I see, since you're both a manager and a former athlete, that perspective is precise.
lines.style: Kenji responds with respectful, slightly formal middle-manager tone and attentiveness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: サッカーで世界一を目指すチームは、なるべく相手の弱点を突くだろう?
lines.en: A soccer team aiming to be world's best targets the opponent's weakness, right?
lines.style: Hiroshi uses analogies confidently, drawing parallels with rhetorical questions.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、データ分析が役に立つ場面ですね。我々も同じ手法で市場を読むべきです。
lines.en: Yes, that's where data analysis proves useful. We should read markets similarly.
lines.style: Kenji agrees thoughtfully and extends the analogy with professional input.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 去年、君は珍しく大型契約を立て続けに収めてくれたな。あれは見事だった。
lines.en: Last year, you unusually landed several big contracts in a row. Quite impressive.
lines.style: Hiroshi praises with reserved warmth, recalling specific achievements directly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 恐縮です。正直、あの数字をプレゼンの資料に大きなカッコで囲んで強調しました。
lines.en: I'm flattered. Honestly, I highlighted those figures in big brackets on my slides.
lines.style: Kenji deflects praise humbly while sharing a small candid practical detail.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 謙遜するな。君の勝負勘は実に頼もしい。今期もその調子で頼む。
lines.en: Don't be modest. Your competitive instinct is truly reliable. Keep that pace this quarter.
lines.style: Hiroshi shifts to warmer encouragement while maintaining executive composure throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。全力で取り組みます。
lines.en: Thank you very much. I'll commit myself fully to the task.
lines.style: Kenji closes with sincere, energized commitment in standard polite register.
